title: THREE-PEAT: NU ‘tribe’ brings the vibes for third straight UAAP CDC crown
summary: The National University Pep Squad delivered a near-flawless performance to complete a three-peat in the UAAP Season 89 Cheerdance Competition on Saturday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay.
